invite2.title.en: Bring a second observer to your unit
invite2.title.ha: Kawo mai lura na biyu zuwa rukunin zaɓenka
invite2.title.ig: Kpọta onye na-ekiri ihe nke abụọ na ngalaba ntuli aka gị
invite2.title.yo: Mú olùwòran kejì wá sí ẹ̀ka ìdìbò rẹ

invite2.why.en: When two observers at the same unit report the same numbers, its count is verified.
invite2.why.ha: Idan masu lura biyu a rukunin zaɓe ɗaya suka bayar da alkaluma iri ɗaya, ana tabbatar da ƙidayarsa.
invite2.why.ig: Mgbe ndị na-ekiri ihe abụọ n'otu ngalaba ntuli aka kọrọ otu ọnụọgụ ahụ, ngụkọ ya na-aghọ nke e nyochara.
invite2.why.yo: Nígbà tí olùwòran méjì ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò kan náà bá ròyìn nọ́ńbà kan náà, a ó fìdí ìkàyè rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

invite2.button.ig: Kpọọ onye na-ekiri ihe nke abụọ

invite2.share-text.en: Watch my polling unit with me on Hawkeye. When two of us report the same numbers there, the count is verified.
invite2.share-text.ha: Ka sa ido a rukunin zaɓena tare da ni a Hawkeye. Idan mu biyu muka bayar da alkaluma iri ɗaya a can, ana tabbatar da ƙidayar.
invite2.share-text.ig: Soro m kiri ngalaba ntuli aka m na Hawkeye. Mgbe anyị abụọ kọrọ otu ọnụọgụ ahụ n'ebe ahụ, ngụkọ ahụ na-aghọ nke e nyochara.
invite2.share-text.yo: Bá mi ṣọ́ ẹ̀ka ìdìbò mi lórí Hawkeye. Tí àwa méjèèjì bá ròyìn nọ́ńbà kan náà níbẹ̀, a ó fìdí ìkàyè náà múlẹ̀.

invite2.failed.en: Could not make your invite link. Tap to try again.
invite2.failed.ha: An kasa ƙirƙirar hanyar gayyatarka. Danna don sake gwadawa.
invite2.failed.ig: Enweghị ike ịmepụta njikọ ọkpụkpọ gị. Pịa ka ị nwaa ọzọ.
invite2.failed.yo: A kò lè ṣe ọ̀nà ìpè rẹ. Tẹ̀ láti tún gbìyànjú.

invite2.choose-first.en: Save your polling unit first, then invite a second observer to it.
invite2.choose-first.ha: Ka fara ajiye rukunin zaɓenka, sannan ka gayyaci mai lura na biyu zuwa gare shi.
invite2.choose-first.ig: Buru ụzọ chekwaa ngalaba ntuli aka gị, wee kpọọ onye na-ekiri ihe nke abụọ ka ọ bịa ebe ahụ.
invite2.choose-first.yo: Kọ́kọ́ fi ẹ̀ka ìdìbò rẹ pamọ́, lẹ́yìn náà pe olùwòran kejì síbẹ̀.

invite2.saved-title.yo: A ti fi ẹ̀ka ìdìbò pamọ́

invite2.prefilled.en: You were invited to this unit. Save it, or choose another.
invite2.prefilled.ha: An gayyace ka zuwa wannan rukunin zaɓe. Ajiye shi, ko ka zaɓi wani.
invite2.prefilled.ig: A kpọrọ gị ka ị bịa ngalaba ntuli aka a. Chekwaa ya, ma ọ bụ họrọ nke ọzọ.
invite2.prefilled.yo: A pè ọ́ sí ẹ̀ka ìdìbò yìí. Fi í pamọ́, tàbí yan òmíràn.

invite2.unit-label.en: The polling unit you were invited to
invite2.unit-label.ha: Rukunin zaɓen da aka gayyace ka zuwa gare shi
invite2.unit-label.ig: Ngalaba ntuli aka a kpọrọ gị ka ị bịa
invite2.unit-label.yo: Ẹ̀ka ìdìbò tí a pè ọ́ sí

invite2.unit-note.en: When the app asks for your polling unit, choose this one — or change it.
invite2.unit-note.ha: Idan manhajar ta tambaye ka rukunin zaɓenka, zaɓi wannan — ko ka canza shi.
invite2.unit-note.ig: Mgbe ngwa ahụ jụrụ gị ngalaba ntuli aka gị, họrọ nke a — ma ọ bụ gbanwee ya.
invite2.unit-note.yo: Nígbà tí ohun èlò bá béèrè ẹ̀ka ìdìbò rẹ, yan èyí — tàbí yí i padà.
